scenarios.description: Hovering a ready generated card fades in an outline and right-click hint without changing composer state.
Right-clicking a ready card prevents the native menu, selects it and writes its reference into the composer.
Right-clicking additional ready cards preserves prior selections and adds independently removable composer chips.
scenarios.fixture: Three ready widgets across both surfaces

scenarios.description: Right-clicking an already selected card removes only that card from the citation collection.
Removing one composer citation chip clears only its matching card treatment.
Submitting a follow-up captures all currently selected sources and later selection changes do not rewrite it.
scenarios.fixture: Two selected ready widgets and one follow-up

scenarios.description: A loading card does not intercept right-click or become selected.
Selection remains visible while fade transitions are disabled when reduced motion is requested.
